headline: Synopsys posts an AMS verification role describing reusable models and monitors across IP families
fact: Synopsys posted a Hyderabad senior staff role to own AMS verification plans, environments, coverage, and sign-off for mixed-signal IP blocks and subsystems. Its description combines SystemVerilog/UVM with Verilog-A and Verilog-AMS models and mixed-signal simulators, and calls for behavioral models and monitors to be reused across IP families. Requested circuit knowledge includes bias circuits, regulators, PLLs, ADCs, and DACs. A September 28 posting repeats this IP-verification mandate and is grouped with the September 3 listing.

sources.title: Synopsys: Sr Staff Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer (18564)
sources.summary: The official posting is dated September 3, 2026, and describes AMS verification of Synopsys IP, cross-family model/monitor reuse, and automation. It does not explicitly name RNM.
